description: This source file defines a MonoBehaviour class 'ButtonHandler' used in Unity to handle button states for cross-platform input. It provides methods to set button and axis states via the CrossPlatformInputManager.

classes.name: ButtonHandler
classes.description: Handles button press states in Unity's cross-platform input system.

methods.name: SetDownState
methods.description: Sets the button state to 'down' using the specified button name.

methods.name: SetUpState
methods.description: Sets the button state to 'up' using the specified button name.

methods.name: SetAxisPositiveState
methods.description: Sets the axis to a positive state.

methods.name: SetAxisNeutralState
methods.description: Resets the axis to a neutral (zero) state.

methods.name: SetAxisNegativeState
methods.description: Sets the axis to a negative state.
